findings.reason: the two shares are nested, not additive, so the plan overstates §23's standalone value (1.4% residual, not 47%) and should say its evidence is a post-§22 profile and that its benefit follows §22's landing.
findings.text: §23's Why presents 47.0% of a 6,078-sample profile as a cost distinct from §22's 86.1%, but in that same profile 2,771 of the 2,854 `_unparsed_section_warnings` samples (and 2,589 of the profile's 2,665 BeautifulSoup-construction samples) sit inside `_resolve_plan_ref`, which §22 replaces with an index read; only 83 samples (1.4% of the profile) are the top-level plan read's own diagnostics
